message:
Both drafts are feasible and pass all checks:

- Each has 13 credits, within your 12–16 limit, includes required CAP4000 and lab 90010, and preserves protected sections 90001 and 90002.
- Your CS3000 grade of B satisfies the prerequisite alternative; CS3500 is not also required.
- Neither has class overlaps or conflicts with your Tuesday/Thursday noon–5 p.m. work hours. Both include Thursday lab, 5:30–6:20 p.m.

Plan A has CAP4000 Monday/Wednesday, 8–9:15 a.m. It keeps Tuesday/Thursday mornings free but requires earlier starts.

Plan B has CAP4000 Tuesday/Thursday, 10–11:40 a.m., leaving 20 minutes before work. I favor B for its later starts if that travel window works for you. Neither fully matches your afternoon-class preference, which is a preference rather than a hard constraint.

Both would replace elective 90003 if registered. Only drafts were created; nothing was saved or registered, and your enrollment is unchanged.
